text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers loud enough to reach the heavens 
echo out. On this day, <chrname> became Japan's 
very first Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the podium, words of 
blessing were showered by people from all 
over the world—and from Mei Satake, who 
had kept the dream alive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> lifts the trophy high. Its weight felt 
like the accumulated weight of all the 
dreams of becoming the world's best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...And once more, a flame is kindled. In 
the heart of one who pursues the next 
great dream—"
